t: Mapei Mapesil AC 100 is a high-performance, solvent-free silicone sealant, engineered for extensive sealing applications in demanding environments. This versatile sealant is perfect for trade professionals installing sanitaryware, wash basins, bath tubs, and shower trays in both interior and exterior locations. Its advanced formula provides waterproof and mould-resistant protection, effectively preventing mildew and resisting various chemicals, making it ideal for wet rooms and bathrooms. Capable of withstanding temperatures up to 180°C and even suitable for underwater use, this durable white silicone sealant ensures a professional, long-lasting finish that can colour coordinate with Mapei Ultracolour Plus Grout.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
